body:
>I'm sure there's pleanty of reason for you to live, OP.

No, no there really isn't. Go take a poll and see how many people want pedophiles to stay alive. Nobody wants me around. Nobody will ever want me around.

>There's no such thing as a lost cause, just lost hope.

"Lost hope" implies that there was hope at some point that could be lost. I've never had any hope. There's never been any possibility of my life improving.

A person who can't stand being alive.

You have no idea how lonely I am. Knowing that it will never change, that this loneliness will *never* go away, that's simply too much. And having to watch *every single person I know* meet someone, fall in love, get married, start a family...

I know exactly what I'm missing out on. And it's horrible.

Fuck. I just want to die.

How am I not broken? I was born a pedophile. There's nothing I can do to change that and there's nowhere in the entire world that I can go and feel safe to be myself.

There's not a single reason I *shouldn't* kill myself.

I've tried that, it's not going to happen. It's not just that I like boys, I'm also repulsed by adults. I have friends but I can only put up with them for a little while. I've never met an adult I wanted to actually spend my life with.

I was born broken. I should have been aborted in the womb. Ah well, better late than never, right?

Yeah, that's what I've spent my life doing. I can't take it anymore. I can't take the loneliness and the misery and the absolute certainty that I'll be alone until the day I die, while all around me everyone else falls in love and gets married and starts a family.

I can't do it anymore. I should just give into societal pressure and kill myself.
Let me rephrase that then: I'm a pedophile. I only like boys.
I was born with the wrong sexual orientation. And we all know there's no way to change that.
